# Investment Tracker App - Instructions

## Project Overview

This is a financial investment tracking application built with:

- **Frontend:** Next.js 14 (App Router) with TypeScript
- **Database:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **Authentication:** Supabase Auth
- **PWA:** Next-PWA
- **Icons:** Lucide React
- **Charts:** Recharts
- **Forms:** React Hook Form + Zod

## Features

- User authentication via Supabase
- Investment portfolio management
- Transaction tracking (buy/sell/dividends)
- Performance charts and reports
- Mobile-responsive PWA
- Real-time data synchronization

## Development Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for all files
- Follow Next.js 14 App Router conventions
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Use Supabase for authentication and data
- Maintain clean component architecture
